items.title: Stock Market Today, Sept. 24: Oracle Stock Dips As it Issues Force Majeure Notice on Project Jupiter Data Center
items.summary: Today, Sept. 24, 2026, the enterprise cloud giant filed to shield itself from cost and payment risk as the New Mexico facility faces public opposition and permitting delays.

items.title: Adobe Stock Slides 18%: Value Play or Falling Knife?
items.summary: Adobe (ADBE) stock has fallen about 18% from its August 31 high, and the question is whether to buy. Its own trading history warrants caution: after past sharp drops, the stock was higher a year later only half the time. And Adobe is trading some near-term recurring-revenue growth for free users, a bet management says will play out over 2027.

items.title: What Is Salesforce No Longer Telling You?
items.summary: Salesforce (CRM) stock has gained 56% in three months, against 5.0% for the S&P 500. Buyers are betting that AI will lift Salesforce rather than undercut its seat-based model. For that gain to hold, two things must both be true. Salesforce's own AI must earn real money, and its new AI pitch must speed up growth. The first depends on an idea management no longer leads with. The second rests on what replaced it. So what idea did Salesforce management once stress on its calls.

items.title: Adobe Rises 24% in 3 Months: Should You Buy, Sell or Hold the Stock?
items.summary: ADBE shares jump 24.4% in three months as AI monetization, user growth and a raised fiscal 2026 outlook boost operating momentum.

items.title: NOW Expands Legacy Replacement Push With AI Platform: What's Ahead?
items.summary: ServiceNow is gaining traction, replacing legacy CRM and workflow tools as AI automation boosts expansion across enterprise workflows and drives customer growth.

items.title: Palantir vs. Salesforce: One Trades at 144x Earnings. Only One Pays You to Own It.
items.summary: Palantir trades at a much richer valuation than Salesforce, but only one pays you to hold it. Here's how growth, margins, and payouts stack up.

items.title: Microsoft Stock’s Big Test: Delivering on a $678 Billion Backlog
items.summary: Microsoft's next phase of growth may depend less on new customers than on serving the ones it has. The stock has run hard, returning 37% over three months against 5.0% for the S&P 500. At a market value of about $3.7 trillion, any new business must be large to move the shares. Will new data center capacity arrive fast enough to serve the demand Microsoft (MSFT) has already won.

items.title: Can Salesforce’s New AIforce Layer Deepen Its Ecosystem Moat and Monetization Story for CRM?
items.summary: At Dreamforce 2026, Salesforce unveiled AIforce, an open, provider-agnostic AI layer, and highlighted rapid adoption of its AI products, including Agentforce and Data Cloud 360, supported by integrations with AWS and Google Cloud. This push to embed governed, agentic AI across partner ecosystems and customer workflows suggests Salesforce is increasingly positioning its platform as the operational backbone for enterprise AI.
